title: feat: ManyChat Lead Capture Agent — first Warden-connected agent
body: ## Summary First agent that connects to the Warden Engine: **ManyChat Lead Capture Agent**. - `workflows/manychat-lead-capture.json` — n8n workflow with 2 nodes: - **ManyChat Webhook** (`POST /webhook/manychat/lead`) — receives lead data - **Transform & Submit to Warden** (Code node) — extracts 6 fields (`first_name`, `last_name`, `phone`, `email`, `interest`, `source`), builds Warden payload with `target_service: 'Google_Sheets'`, POSTs to Warden intake - Supports both flat and `custom_fields`-nested ManyChat payload formats - Maps to CNY Pre-Launch List sheet columns: First Name, Last Name, Phone, Email, Interest, Source, Date Added, Status - `docs/manychat-webhook-template.md` — copy-paste setup guide for ManyChat Flow Builder (custom fields, External Request config, curl test example) Tested end-to-end on live tunnel: ManyChat webhook → Warden intake (PENDING) → approve → EXECUTED (Google_Sheets simulated — no credential configured yet). Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/622fa465b063406c90cc1af313d90823 Requested by: @Cannibusny ---
